candidates.body: Tupac’s murder has finally been solved. Former gang boss Duane “Keffe D” Davis has been found guilty of orchestrating the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, who was killed on September 13, 1996. The 63-year-old was convicted by a Las Vegas jury of a single count of murder with a deadly weapon and could be sentenced to life in prison. : ABC News. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

candidates.headline: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur?
candidates.body: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur? ⁣ ⁣ This week, after someone was finally convicted of killing the rap icon, fans were quick to call Keffe D an idiot for admitting to crimes on camera and in his book. ⁣ ⁣ But there may have been a very good reason why he assumed he'd never get convicted and why even local police thought the crime would never get solved. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
